en: Lowers all allies' AC by 3. Stackable.
Shows any dead adventurers on the current floor.
Lights the dungeon so hidden mechanisms are easier to find. No time limit.
Cures all allies of Sleep, Silence, Confusion, Charm and Fear.
note: Status names as in ebt / ITEM_HELP.

en: Lowers all allies' AC by 2. Lasts the whole expedition.
note: [JP] = stays in effect for the whole trip (until back in town); contrasts with the in-battle [JP] version.

en: Returns the party to the castle. Forgotten once cast.
note: [JP]: the spell is lost from the caster's list after one use.

en: Cures all allies of every ailment except Petrification, Death and Ash.
Fully restores one ally's HP and cures all ailments but Death and Ash.
Creates a barrier that blocks one breath attack. Can be stacked.
note: Same pattern as ITEM_HELP drain-barrier row (slice_19:1550).

en: In exchange for all MP, cuts every enemy's current HP by a set ratio.
Has a chance to revive one ally from Death or Ash.
Has a chance to instantly kill one enemy row.
High chance to paralyze one enemy.
Identifies the trap on a treasure chest.
Has a chance to paralyze one enemy row.
Hides one ally so enemies won't target them.
High chance to confuse one enemy.
Has a chance to confuse one enemy row.
note: Same as ITEM_HELP slice_19:1588 minus the [Instrument] tag.

en: Draws enemy attacks onto one ally.
High chance to charm one enemy.
Resets stat changes made in battle for friend and foe.
note: Same as ITEM_HELP slice_19:1577 minus the [Instrument] tag.

en: Restores all allies' items that were broken in battle.
Has a chance to charm one enemy row.
Safely disarms the trap on a treasure chest.
Grants a special wish, but is forgotten once cast.
Forms a contract with a monster.

note: UNCERTAIN: designer label with a width ruler ([JP] + full-width 3..12). Kept as 'Contract' + ruler digits to a 12-char width. Probably not player-visible. Spell name [JP] itself not yet fixed (slice_48).
Learning stat; ebt [JP] = Piety, cf. Ankh of Piety.
[JP] = Hunter (glossary, csvt majority). ebt slice_16:1305 has 'Ranger'; conflict flagged.
[JP] = magic puppet (glossary term). ebt race list slice_17:1355 has 'Puppet'; conflict flagged.

en: Received the Blessing of Dark Oblivion
note: Rogera; [JP] = Dark Oblivion (glossary [JP]). 38/38 bytes. ebt slice_08:640 has [JP] = 'Blessing of Dark Ruin'; conflict flagged.
